details.description:
Generative AI software can respond to a wide variety of requests. However, the quality of its answers depends greatly on the questions we ask—in other words, the prompts we give it.
In this module, you will learn how to write effective prompts and refine your requests to improve the output produced by generative AI software.
objectives: Critically assess the response from generative AI software
Improve the response produced by generative AI software

element.content:
Tom is organising a volleyball tournament at a sports club. 🏐

He wants to save time, so he asks generative AI software to help him organise the tournament.

But he is disappointed with the result…

messages.content: Emma, I don't understand… You manage to do loads of things with AI, but it just doesn't work for me!
Really? What prompt did you use?
My prompt was: "Help me organise the tournament."
That's because your request is too vague! The AI can't guess what you want. 😉

element.content: That's right: you can improve the software's output by being more precise. It is just like talking to someone—you are more likely to be understood when you explain things clearly.
Tom's prompt was: "Help me organise the tournament."

element.instruction: What do you think should be added to Tom's prompt to improve it?

valid.diagnosis: You should provide as much detail as possible. The more information the AI has about the situation, the better its response will be.

invalid.diagnosis: You should provide as much detail as possible. The more information the AI has about the situation, the better its response will be.

element.content:
🤔 So, what details should you include in your prompt?

Anything that provides context: the objective, the audience, the place, the time, and so on.

This gives meaning to the request.

Without this context, the AI may give a vague or irrelevant answer. 🕳️
Tom wrote an invitation to the tournament and asked the AI to correct it.

element.instruction: You can use AI to change the tone of this message.

messages.content:
I wrote this invitation to the tournament. Can you check it for mistakes?
"Hi everyone,
Just a friendly reminder that registration for the volleyball tournament is still open, but not for much longer! You have until Friday."

Here is a corrected version of the message:
"Hi everyone,
Just a friendly reminder that registration for the volleyball tournament is still open, but not for much longer! You have until Friday."

element.content:
🤔 How can we get an answer that really meets our needs?

To get a suitable result, you can specify :

  • who you are addressing (a seven-year-old child, a subject expert, etc.), 👥
  • how (briefly, clearly, professionally, etc.),💬
  • a role to play ("as a sports coach", "as if you were Julius Caesar", etc.).🎭

grains.title: Use the right format in your prompt

element.content:
Tom wants to train the players at his club ahead of the volleyball tournament.

To do this, he is preparing a training document on forearm passing, in the form of a table.

Level Exercise Description
Beginner Forearm pass against a wall The player practises forearm passes alone against a wall, keeping the ball under control.
Intermediate Forearm-pass triangle Three players form a triangle and pass the ball to one another using forearm passes.
Advanced Live serve reception A player receives powerful serves using a forearm pass.
Expert ... ...

grains.title: Discovery: Help Tom with his prompt

element.content:
He is short of ideas for exercises aimed at expert players.


Use the generative AI software below to help him produce a complete table containing exercises for players of all levels.

element.title: LLM simulator
element.instruction: Your turn: you have five prompts to succeed!

element.title: 💡 Practical tip
element.content:
❌ Do you sometimes send your prompt when you only meant to start a new line?

✅ To start a new line, press Shift ⬆️ and Enter at the same time.

element.title: 🗝️ Hint 1
element.content:
Have you thought about giving the AI the existing table?

You can copy and paste it into your prompt!

element.title: 🗝️ Hint 2
element.content: Have you checked that the resulting table includes forearm-pass exercises for different levels, including expert level?

element.title: 🙈 Solution
element.content:
A correct answer must : 
  • be structured as a table,
  • contain exercises for improving forearm passing in volleyball, 
  • include one or more new exercises for expert players.
If these conditions are met, your answer should be accepted. ✅

grains.title: The importance of format and iteration in prompts

elements.content:
🤔 How can you use generative AI software effectively?
  • Specify the required format, for example, a text, a table, a list, a mind map, and so on.
  • Add constraints, such as length(" in fewer than 10 lines ") or structure(" use two sections, each with two subsections").

You can also ask the AI to use an example as a starting point and reproduce it.

🤔 What if the AI's response does not meet our expectations?

No problem—continue the conversation with the AI and ask it to make changes…

grains.title: Recap: the essentials of writing good prompts

element.content:
A few tips for writing an effective prompt :

  • Use an action verb.
  • Provide context.
  • Specify the tone where relevant.
  • Give the AI an identity or a role where necessary.
  • Specify the expected format.

🔄 After each response, you can adjust or refine your prompt to get a better result.

⚠️ A response may appear clear and well written while containing information that does not match what was requested or is partly incorrect.

🔍 Reviewing the AI's response is essential before using it or presenting it to someone.

Tom has made his prompts more precise and improved the way he communicates with generative AI software. 

For each prompt, select all the elements that make it clear.

elements.content: " Write a dialogue between spectators at a volleyball match. "

valid.diagnosis: These elements make the prompt clear, although it is not always necessary to include all of them.

invalid.diagnosis:
The elements that make this prompt clear are: 

  • the specified format: a dialogue,
  • and the context: a volleyball match.

elements.content: " As a comedian, write a short, humorous speech (two to three minutes) for a leaving party for a volleyball player on your team who is moving to another town. Include his main qualities (sense of humour, skill and honesty) and his minor flaws (impatient and talkative). "

valid.diagnosis: All these elements make the prompt clear, although it is not always necessary to include all of them.

invalid.diagnosis:
The elements that make this prompt clear are: 

  • the format: a speech, 
  • the tone: humorous,
  • and the context, provided by the description of a volleyball player's leaving party and specific details such as his qualities and flaws.

element.content:
Tom took notes during the tournament planning meeting : 

- maximum 12 teams. mixed teams → everyone agrees

- prizes? medals → cost to be confirmed

- referees → volunteers; follow up with those from the last tournament

- music: ask the town hall about a sound system

- if it rains → is the sports hall available? yes!:-)

- refreshments: juice, sandwiches, fruit → no hot food

Tom wants to send report to those who could not attend.

Talk to the generative AI software below until you obtain report that accurately reflect Tom's notes.

🗝️ If you need help, click the hints below :


Hint 1

Have you checked the result produced by the AI?

Hint 2

Have you checked the prizes in the report?

Hint 3

Have you asked the AI to correct its response?

element.title: 🙈 Solution
element.content:
If you have produced report, the software has probably made a mistake. The tournament prizes in Tom's notes are medals. 🎖️

You therefore need to ask the software to correct this mistake.

If you have obtained corrected report that include the medals, your answer should be accepted. ✅

🎯 Mission: find a venue for the Jolieville tournament!

Tom is looking for a venue that can host the volleyball tournament. He needs at least four courts.

His maximum budget is 300 pixmoney, but he is of course looking for a good deal. 💸

Jolieville town council has created AI software to answer questions about its sports facilities. 🥅
